title: Fox holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <path d='M58 42 Q62 55 55 68' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>

  <ellipse cx='60' cy='30' rx='12' ry='14' fill='#ff4d6d'/>

  <!-- Balloon highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='24' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#ffd0d8'/>
  <!-- Fox body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='72' rx='16' ry='15' fill='#ff8c42'/>
  <!-- Fox tail -->
  <path d='M27 78 Q14 72 16 60 Q22 64 27 66 Q30 72 27 78Z' fill='#ff8c42'/>
  <path d='M16 60 Q21 63 24 66 Q20 68 17 67Z' fill='#fff4e0'/>

  <ellipse cx='54' cy='53' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ffb38a'/>

  <ellipse cx='39' cy='48' rx='2.2' ry='2.8' fill='#2a1a12'/>
  <ellipse cx='51' cy='48' rx='2.2' ry='2.8' fill='#2a1a12'/>
  <circle cx='39.8' cy='47' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='51.8' cy='47' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <ellipse cx='45' cy='54' rx='2.5' ry='1.8' fill='#2a1a12'/>

  <path d='M45 56 Q48 59 50 57' stroke='#2a1a12' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='67' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#ff8c42'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='68' rx='3.5' ry='2.8' fill='#ff8c42'/>

  <ellipse cx='42' cy='70' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#fff4e0'/>

  <ellipse cx='33' cy='85' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#ff8c42'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='85' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#ff8c42'/>
